whatItIs: QFlow-lite is an open-source project in the quantum machine learning category. It is maintained by jpzwolak and primarily looks like a Python codebase. This document is intended as a User Guide for anyone interested in training a machine learning (ML) model using the quantum dot dataset available on data.nist.gov.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches quantum machine learning workflows in practice. Zwolak *et al.*, QFlow lite dataset: A machinelearning approach to the charge states in quantum dot experiments. *PLoS ONE* **13**(10): e0205844 (2018).
